description: Create std/math/patterns.mm with reusable proof-pattern atoms for finance, payments, and smart-contract verification. Generated atoms must mirror MumeiLean.Patterns names and use only existing Mumei scalar syntax already present in std/contracts.mm and std/math/*.mm.

atoms.name: bounded_mul_with_overflow_check
atoms.description: Multiply two non-negative i64 values under explicit bounds and prove the result stays within the caller-provided overflow limit.
atoms.requires: a >= 0 && b >= 0 && limit >= 0 && a <= limit && b <= limit && a * b <= limit
atoms.ensures: result >= 0 && result <= limit && result == a * b

atoms.name: clamp_preserves_order
atoms.description: Clamp x into [min_val, max_val] and prove the result is bounded by the interval.

atoms.name: round_trip_conversion
atoms.description: Encode/decode a scaled integer and prove round-trip identity within a declared valid range.
atoms.requires: scale > 0 && min_val <= x && x <= max_val && (x * scale) / scale == x
atoms.ensures: result == x && result >= min_val && result <= max_val

atoms.name: sum_invariant
atoms.description: Compare before/after arrays pointwise and prove their aggregate sum is preserved.
atoms.requires: n >= 0 && len(before_values) >= n && len(after_values) >= n && forall(i, 0, n, before_values[i] >= 0 && after_values[i] >= 0 && before_values[i] == after_values[i])
atoms.body_pattern: loop over 0..n accumulating before_sum and after_sum with invariant before_sum == after_sum; return after_sum - before_sum

atoms.name: count_invariant
atoms.description: Compare before/after arrays pointwise and prove the count of target values is preserved.
atoms.requires: n >= 0 && len(before_values) >= n && len(after_values) >= n && forall(i, 0, n, before_values[i] == after_values[i])
atoms.body_pattern: loop over 0..n counting target occurrences in both arrays with invariant before_count == after_count; return after_count - before_count
